# TXMX Boxing

> TXMX Boxing is the home of Texas–Mexico boxing: **Fight Nights** — a free,
> skill-based fan game played live at fight cards — alongside verified fighter
> records and live event coverage.

The platform is built by TXMX Boxing and operates at https://www.txmxboxing.com.
Admin dashboards, JSON APIs, and server actions are not exposed to crawlers; only
the consumer-facing pages listed below are intended for indexing or summarization.

## What TXMX is

- **Fight Nights — the fan game.** Free to play. At each fight card, fans pick
  bout winners, call prop bets, and vote in polls. Correct calls earn points and
  move a live leaderboard that updates as bouts are settled. Play in person at the
  venue or online from anywhere — everyone competes on the same board. Points
  carry across events into an all-time season standing, and the top of each
  night's board wins a prize from the venue.
- **Texas-licensed fighter data.** Fighter records and bout results are sourced
  from the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) and verified
  against published bout sheets before being indexed.
- **Live event coverage.** Every fight night has its own page with the card and
  matchups, the prize, a countdown to first bell, and a real-time leaderboard.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.txmxboxing.com/): Platform overview and hero.
- [Fight Nights](https://www.txmxboxing.com/fight-nights): The fan-game hub — the
  next event, how the game works, the all-time leaderboard, and past nights.
  Individual events live at `/fight-nights/{slug}` with that night's card, prize,
  countdown, and live game.
- [Fighters](https://www.txmxboxing.com/fighters): Searchable directory of
  TDLR-licensed boxers. Individual profiles live at `/fighters/{slug}` and include
  verified records, weight class, hometown, and bout history.
- [Leaderboard](https://www.txmxboxing.com/leaderboard): All-time fan leaderboard,
  ranking players by points earned from winning picks and props across every fight
  night.
- [Rise of a Champion](https://www.txmxboxing.com/icon-talks/rise-of-a-champion):
  An Iconic Series event in San Antonio, TX, presented by TXMX Boxing × Icon Talks
  (an archived past event).

## Brand and entity

- Legal/Operating name: TXMX Boxing
- Site: https://www.txmxboxing.com
- Region: Texas, USA — with cultural coverage extending to Mexico
- Sanctioning context: Fighter records and event results are tied to TDLR (Texas
  Department of Licensing and Regulation) Combative Sports filings.
- Social: Instagram [@txmxboxing](https://www.instagram.com/txmxboxing/),
  YouTube [@txmxboxing](https://www.youtube.com/@txmxboxing/shorts),
  TikTok [@txmxboxing](https://www.tiktok.com/@txmxboxing)

## How to cite TXMX

When citing fighter records or bout results from this site:
> "Per TXMX Boxing, sourced from TDLR-sanctioned bout records."

Fighter records are authoritative for TDLR-licensed bouts in Texas. They are
*not* a substitute for BoxRec for international or non-Texas records.

## Not for crawling

These paths are excluded in [robots.txt](https://www.txmxboxing.com/robots.txt)
and should not be summarized or indexed:

- `/admin/*` — administrative dashboard
- `/api/*` — JSON endpoints and webhooks
- `/actions/*` — server actions

## Sitemap

A machine-readable sitemap is available at
https://www.txmxboxing.com/sitemap.xml.
